dct_description_sm: Belarus administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 7 - Admin 2: 119 Dates associated with this dataset: - 21 November 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 27 July 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 30 July 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 30 July 2019: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
